pattern: SELECT COUNT\(*\) as [a-zA-Z0-9]+ FROM [a-zA-Z0-9]+ GROUP BY [a-zA-Z0-9]+
correction: Replace 'COUNT(\*)' with 'SUM([column_name])', where [column_name] is the column you are summing.

metadata.description: This rule corrects SQL queries that count all records instead of summing up a specific column.
